**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 516 <sup>4.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
Caverns can be covered in rubble, which is difficult terrain. Deep or pervasive rubble is also uneven ground.
</column>
